title: Unify verb, command, and act into action / actions across engine, routes, frontend, and tests

sections.what: Rip out `verb` / `action_verbs` / `VerbSpec` / `ActionVerbs`, `/api/action` payload key `command`, and plan step key `act` across Python, TypeScript, templates, tooling, and tests so the entire codebase uses one canonical name: `action` (`actions` for collections).
sections.why: Measured blast radius across the repo is bounded (14 files for `action_verbs`/`ActionVerbs`/`VerbSpec`, 18 files for `command` payload keys, 10 files for plan step `act`), yet four different labels (`action`, `verb`, `command`, `act`) currently describe the exact same thing.
sections.how:
1. Rename `engine/action_verbs.py` -> `engine/actions.py` (`ActionSpec`, `ACTION_SPECS`, `all_actions`), `tools/action_verbs_index.py` -> `tools/actions_index.py`, and `static/js/agent/action-verbs.generated.js` -> `static/js/agent/actions.generated.js` (`window.Actions`), updating `templates/index.html` and all 12 caller files.
2. Replace `data.get('command')` / `{'command': ...}` in `routes/action_handlers.py`, `mcp_server.py`, `tools/autoswarm/actor.py`, frontend API callers, and the 14 test files with `action`.
3. Replace plan step `act` / `PLAN_INTENT_ACTS` in `static/js/agent/plan-grounding.ts`, `plan-manager.ts`, `plan-tracker.ts`, `structured-formats.ts`, and unit tests with `action` / `PLAN_INTENT_ACTIONS`.
4. Fold in `bug-598` and `bug-600` so every dispatched action is registered and `tests/test_actions.py` passes with 0 failures.
sections.verify: Run `python tools/actions_index.py --check`, `npm run build:ts`, `pytest`, and `node tools/unit/run.cjs` across action, plan, and prompt suites.

acceptance.text: Registry, spec types, generator script, and browser global use `engine/actions.py`, `ActionSpec`, `tools/actions_index.py`, `static/js/agent/actions.generated.js`, and `window.Actions` with zero remaining `action_verbs` / `VerbSpec` / `ActionVerbs` references.
`/api/action` callers and handlers use `action` instead of `command`, and typed plan steps use `action` / `PLAN_INTENT_ACTIONS` instead of `act` / `PLAN_INTENT_ACTS`.
`npm run build:ts`, `pytest tests/test_actions.py`, and JS unit tests pass.
